name: Calendar Notes
description: A minimal month-view calendar for keeping day-by-day notes.
releaseNotes: The floating month style is rebuilt as one continuous five-week strip: paging walks on from the previous page with no repeated or skipped days, the weeks-above setting keeps that many rows before the week containing today, and jumping or arrowing to a date simply turns the strip to the page holding it. The month title now doubles as a date picker — pick a year, a month and a day to jump straight there.
